name: Outbound Access Protection for dbt job
description: Outbound access protection is supported by dbt job items. When OAP is enabled on a workspace, dbt jobs run under the workspace's outbound access policy — outbound network calls from the dbt job are blocked unless explicitly allowed.Preview limitation: Public packages are not supported during preview. If OAP is enabled on a workspace containing a dbt job, package resolution from public sources will fail. Support for public packages will be added by GA.
